profile.headline: Tech Elevator Graduate || Knowledge Collector || Art Admirer
profile.summary:
As a trained dancer, I learned invaluable lessons about discipline, determination and passion. The advice of my teacher plays in my mind like a soundtrack to my life. That bad days are when you push a little harder because that's how you grow. Your body is your instrument and you must maintain and train it constantly. Stay focused in order to succeed and be open to absorbing and applying the critiques of your mentor. Consistently pursue your goals even after getting endless strings of "No" . The love for the art inspires you to share it with everyone, in hopes that it will grow with the tenacity of dandelions in a field. 
 I am confident that these values will translate into a successful career in tech because I lead with this mindset in everything I do. I bring passion to projects, no matter how small my role, I want to ensure the best of me can be seen in that work. I take pride in what I do and I see the magic in small details. I value hard work, structure and feedback because they yield efficient results. I want the growth and success for my team and the company I represent. I am excited to leap into this new technical opportunity so that I can put my spin on the industry.

positions.title: Senior Certified Pharmacy Technician
positions.description:
-Championed education for new medical device, Dexcom. Identified best billing and usage practices. Established relationships with local doctor’s offices to facilitate straightforward access for patients. Created training resources for my team.
-Advocated for an increase in 90 day supply refills versus 30 day supply. Resulted in copay discounts for patients, decreased insurance processing fees billed to pharmacy, lowered shipping costs from less supply usage and condensed shipments, cut redundant employee tasks.
-Constructed new procedure for freezing ice packs. Maximized output of usable ice packs without requiring spending on new resources. 
-Supported community during Covid-19 pandemic by working data-entry for vaccination clinics. Prevented a breakdown in workflow by stepping up to run paperwork from the immunization site to the data entry pharmacy after the initial runner dropped out.

positions.title: Java Development Bootcamp Student
positions.description: Graduated from Tech Elevator Java bootcamp.

positions.title: Discover IT Customer Service
positions.description:
-Took 100+ customer service calls in succession while maintaining consistent customer experience.
-Maintained high compliance and metrics scores. Often used as prime example of preferred call format during team calibrations. 
-Enhanced verbal communication skills, sharpened analytical skills, utilized multi-tasking ability. 
-Handled customer service inquiries, explained balances and transactions, discussed relevant programs, processed payments, performed credit line increase/decrease requests, reward redemptions, card activations, processed lost/stolen cards, reviewed statements and APR inquiries.
